propositions: Success Criteria vocabulary has been deprecated in favor of Acceptance Criteria and must be removed from live prose while preserving frozen fixtures, migration evidence, and permanent semantic carve-outs.
A repository guard (check_criteria_vocabulary.py) with count-pinned allowlist must detect and prevent reintroduction of deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary in non-exempted files.

Residual live prose occurrences in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria terminology.

The guard must enforce exact-phrase matching and scoped bare-token (SC/SCs) rules while excluding archives, experiments, vendor bundles, and VCS directories, with specific bare-token paths limited to reviewers, guides, and routing configuration.
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target and must deterministically fail on count drift, malformed allowlist entries, duplicate paths, and stale exemptions.
